# JARVIS v2.3.1 Release Notes

> ⚠️ **CRITICAL UPDATE MANDATORY / ZAROORI NOTICE:**  
> Is naye version (v2.3.1) ke aane ke baad purane sabhi versions ko permanently block kar diya gaya hai. Previous version ke paas sirf limited 3 ghante ka grace period countdown hai, jiske baad app work nahi karegi. App use karne ke liye foran naya update install karna zaroori hai!

### Key Updates & Highlights:

- **100% Non-Root Native Automation:** Superuser/root dependencies ko permanently eliminate kar diya gaya hai; ab poori automation, gestures, reels scrolling, aur controls Android Accessibility Service ke zariye unrooted devices par bina kisi risk ke smoothly chalte hain.
- **Cross-App Messaging & In-Chat Smart Typing:** WhatsApp, Instagram, Telegram aur SMS par voice-command se hands-free message typing aur auto-sending enable kar di gayi hai, chahe aap kisi bhi chat screen ke andar hon.
- **Clean & Unified App Identity Modal:** "About JARVIS" aur "App Identity" dialogs ko clean aur synchronized banaya gaya hai jisme verified **SILENT SOUL** attribution, zero security certificate clutter, aur direct Instagram (`@arif._.96`) + Telegram (`@arif_x9`) channels integrated hain.
- **Girlfriend Mode (Afreen) Polish & Cleanup:** AI companion ke turn ke aakhir mein aane wale trailing unknown/religious words aur hallucinations ko permanently block kar diya gaya hai aur voice warmth ko 0.70 temperature par calibrate kiya gaya hai.
- **Strict Tiered Deprecation & Automatic Grace Period:** Obsolete versions ko open hote hi non-dismissible screen ke sath foran hard-block kiya jata hai (background AI kill ho jati hai), jabki immediate previous build ko 3-hour live countdown timer milta hai.
- **Zero-Backend Privacy Governance:** UI aur source code se open-source references ko completely remove karke 7-Article On-Device Data Sovereignty policy implement kar di gayi hai.
